summary:
**Market summary, 2026-11-16 (prior session: 2026-11-13)**

U.S. equities closed lower. SPY fell 0.36% and QQQ 1.20%, with technology (XLK, -2.01%) leading declines. Defensive sectors were firmer: consumer staples (XLP, +1.42%), health care (XLV, +0.54%) and utilities (XLU, +0.52%). Energy (XLE) gained 0.98% and is up 5.42% over five days. Long Treasuries (TLT) slipped 0.43%, and the VIX short-term futures ETF rose 2.46%.

Economic data: initial jobless claims were 200K against a 194K consensus, and existing home sales were 3.75M against 3.89M expected. Crude inventories rose 4.657M barrels, versus a forecast draw of 0.600M. The 30-year bond auction cleared at 5.441%.

Pre-market at 13:17 UTC, SPY was down 0.58%, QQQ 1.22% and XLK 1.93%.

Perion (PERI) was the most-mentioned eligible name. It reported Q3 sales of $90.8M against a $118.2M estimate, suspended its buyback and withdrew guidance while the Affle deal is pending. Several large pre-market stock moves came on thin volume and may not reflect actual prices.
